title: Gitilla building config (v1)
description: Styles this repository's building in Gitilla. Publish it as .git-city/building.json in the repository's default branch. The repository owner's city.json (repos[name]) wins, field by field. Data only: Gitilla validates every field, ignores unknown keys and never loads URLs from it; over-long text is shortened. See https://github.com/schlunsen/git-city/blob/main/docs/building-config.md

$schema.description: Editor hint only; Gitilla never loads it.

style.description: Silhouette: tower with a spire, stepped tower, cottage with a pitched roof, or a plain block. Height still follows the stars.

color.description: Facade colour (instead of the language colour).

sign.description: Text on the building's shop signs and rooftop board.

billboard.description: Text on this repository's country billboard.

text.description: The words: free-form, up to 60 characters.

color.description: Paint colour (default depends on the style).

style.description: A quick marker tag, fat bubble letters, or a stencil. Default: tag.

neon.description: Night glow colour of the lit windows.

flag.description: An emoji or up to 3 characters on a small rooftop flag.
